header: Cliffwater wrote the book on private debt. Literally. We designed the site with a clear brand voice in mind, knowing the identity work would follow. As the site took shape, its visual language became the foundation for the broader brand system—built from the inside out and shaped by real use.

text: Cliffwater is a leading adviser and fund manager in alternative investments. Known for their rigor and deep expertise, they needed a digital presence that matched their reputation. A full rebrand was on the table, but urgency demanded we start with the site.
Typically, brand leads. But after our first meeting, it was clear the website had to come first.
We proposed an agile rebrand that unfolded alongside the site design. It allowed brand and product to evolve in sync—and it worked.
Private debt is complex by nature. To make it more accessible, we partnered with illustrator Birgit Palma to distill Cliffwater’s institutional knowledge into clear, visual moments.
The goal was to bring clarity to an opaque asset class and build trust with new audiences.
The agile approach to branding proved more effective than anticipated. It’s a model we will carry forward into future work.
